assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and presyncope
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient has unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
The diagnosis codes are I49.9, I34.0, R55
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of collapse
CPT 93247 represents a long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study
The service is medically necessary to identify the arrhythmic cause of the patient's recurrent syncope
